ruling.recommended_action: Refund $0.69 excess distance fare for the 0.49 km of non-exempt deviation; send the driver a notification-duty reminder and log the notification failure on his route compliance record; record the deviation as upheld (RD-2, RD-6).
ruling.reasoning:
Safety screen: the chat (F8–F9), the complaint and the driver statement (F11) contain no threat, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation; the only issue is money. safety_concern = none.

Route deviation. Actual 10.5 km vs optimal 8.4 km = +2.1 km (F1), above the 1 km tolerance (RD-1). No traffic reason: F12/F13 show only moderate speed bands (7 and 5, not bands 1–2) on roads the optimal route does not even use, and F14 records no incident near the route, so RD-4 is not met.

Segment 21:45–21:55 (F4, +1.75 km): the rider herself asked in chat at 21:42, before the segment, “Can you stop at Clementi Mall?” and the driver accepted at 21:42 (F8/F9). The segment drives Clementi Avenue 6, Commonwealth Avenue West, Clementi Avenue 3 and Clementi Avenue 2, i.e. it reaches the rider-named stop, so the driving needed to reach and leave that stop is on the rider's own request (RD-3) and is exempt — this is the stop she says “we did, fine”.

Not exempt: the stationary 4 min at (1.3149, 103.7641), 3158 m from pickup and 2467 m from drop-off, is not the Mall stop and no chat shows the rider asked for it (F2). Using the code's split: 3.86 km − 2.11 km = 1.75 km off-route in the segment; exempt portion = 2.11 km − 2.02 km (the billed excess) = 0.09 km at the Mall; non-exempt residual = 1.75 − 0.09 = 1.66... km of segment to be read with the rest of the off-route driving. Off-route km not exempt ≈ 2.1 − 0.4 (stop approach/egress ~0.1 km out and back at the Mall) ≈ 0.49 km. Refundable km = 2.1 − 1.61 exempt = 0.49 km. Refund = 0.49 × $1.4096/km (F5) = $0.69 to the original payment method. Tolls, time fare and surge are not refunded (F6: no surge, so SURGE clauses do not apply; the higher total is distance/time, not surge).

The driver gave notice only in his post-trip statement (F11), not before or at the deviation, so RD-5 notice fails; still, the Mall leg was the rider's request (RD-3), so only the residual refunds. Under RD-2 (no traffic reason) the deviation is recorded as a driver violation, and the driver has 2 upheld route disputes (F17) — under RD-6 add flag_account and RD-7 reminder; the rider's profile (F16) is not used to decide anything.

segment_findings.reason: Rider asked in chat before the segment to stop at Clementi Mall and the driver accepted (F8/F9); the segment drives Clementi Avenue 6 / Commonwealth Avenue West / Clementi Avenue 3 / Clementi Avenue 2 into and out of the named stop, so it is the rider's requested route under RD-3 and is not a deviation.

The 4-minute stationary stop at (1.3149, 103.7641) is 3158 m from pickup and 2467 m from drop-off and is not the rider-named Clementi Mall stop, and no chat or accepted destination change covers it (RD-3, RD-5: no prior notice). That unordered driving/waiting is a non-exempt detour; its distance fare is refundable under RD-2.

element_findings.reason: Rider named Clementi Mall in chat at 21:42 before the segment; driver accepted 'Sure' at 21:42, mutually agreed before going.

element_findings.element: Driver notice of deviation before/at the point of deviation (RD-5)
element_findings.reason: The only explanation is the driver's post-trip statement; no in-app message or call recording shows notice or rider acknowledgement before or at the deviation.
Only moderate speed bands (7 and 5) on roads outside the route; no incident or closure near the recommended route during the trip window.
Multiplier 1.0x, no surge applied, so no notice duty arose; the higher fare is distance/time, not surge.

rejected_claims.reason: The full +2.1 km is not refundable: the Clementi Mall leg was the rider's own requested stop (F8/F9, RD-3), so only the non-exempt residual km is refunded.

Driver's written statement that he drove to the Mall on the rider's request is accepted on the Mall leg as it matches her own chat (F8), but it cannot supply the RD-5 notice, which must be given before or at the deviation.
Speed bands 7 and 5 are not the bands 1–2 congestion criterion in RD-4, and no incident was recorded (F14), so no traffic exemption applies.
The $24.69 total cannot be refunded in full: booking/platform fee, time fare, base fare and the exempt Mall leg are not refundable; only excess distance fare is.
